skill.name: review-doc
skill.tagline: Blind expert review, section by section, with a whole-document editor
skill.shortSummary: Splits a document into sections and runs blind expert reviews plus a senior editor pass, writing findings to .reviews/.
skill.fullSummary: Review-doc orchestrates a full review by splitting a document at its own headings, briefing one blind expert per section with the section's 5W1H, and running all experts in parallel alongside a senior editor that reviews the whole document. Each expert sees only its own section and brief, keeping reviews independent. Findings are written to a timestamped .reviews/ file with exact quotes, issues, fixes, kinds, severities, and pending outcomes.

highlights.title: Blind section experts
highlights.description: One expert per section sees only its section and a 5W1H brief, so no section review leaks context from the rest of the document.

highlights.title: Whole-document senior editor
highlights.description: A separate editor reviews order, repetition, contradictions, missing sections, and whether the opening promise is delivered.

highlights.title: Structured findings file
highlights.description: Findings are written to .reviews/ with exact quotes, issue, fix, kind, severity, and pending outcome for later triage.

highlights.title: Faithful workflow fallback
highlights.description: When the Workflow tool is absent, the same prompts run as background Fable agent calls per section plus the whole document.

steps.name: Resolve the document
steps.description: Ask for a file if none is supplied and resolve the path.
steps.details: Stops on empty argument, uses paths as given, searches bare names from project root via git ls-files or find, and puts multiple matches to the user.

steps.name: Split the document
steps.description: Read the full document and split at its headings.
steps.details: Merge fragments shorter than a paragraph, record each section's title and line range, and merge smallest neighboring sections when the count exceeds the session workflow guideline.

steps.name: Brief each section
steps.description: Write Who, What, When, Where, Why, How, and the required expert.
steps.details: Describe audience, claims, reader position, file path/lines, purpose, form and evidence, then choose a technical editor, domain specialist, or both.

steps.name: Run the experts
steps.description: Call the Workflow tool with the pinned script and section briefs.
steps.details: One blind Fable expert per section plus a whole-document senior editor run in parallel; fall back to background agent calls when the Workflow tool is absent, and wait for completion.

steps.name: Write the review
steps.details: Use date -u, write .reviews/<stamp>-<stem>.md, number section findings and whole-document findings, mark every finding pending, and report the path and counts.
